message.content: I want to build something that helps me keep track of what I read, but every app I've tried I abandon after a week.
The abandonment is the interesting part, not the tracking. Before we design anything: what were you actually hoping to get out of the record, and what made logging feel like a chore?
Honestly I wanted to be able to find a half-remembered idea again months later. The logging itself never gave me anything back.
